Pharmaceutical_form: Tablets, film-coated or extended release; Oral solution
Disease_class(es): Diseases of the musculoskeletal system and connective tissue

Indication_requested: First-line treatment of patients with epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer in combination with carboplatin and paclitaxel.
Indication_approved: In combination with carboplatin and paclitaxel for the first line treatment of patients with advanced (FIGO stages IIIB, IIIC and IV) epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer.

Indication_requested: treatment of patients with progressive, radioactive iodine refractory differentiated thyroid cancer
Indication_approved: treatment of patients with progressive, locally advanced or metastatic, radioactive iodine refractory differentiated thyroid cancer
